blocks.text: The “Premium” design package — extended interior design in Bratislava and Vienna

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) offers the “Premium” design package for apartments, private houses, and commercial spaces that call for the most detailed interior development, an extended set of technical documentation, and professional support in preparing the project for implementation.

The package combines layout solutions, photorealistic 3D visualizations, a complete set of core technical drawings, room-by-room wall elevations, detail drawings and sections, specifications, and quantity calculations for the main materials.
The package also includes two material-selection trips with the designer.
“Premium” is suited to projects where precise execution, detailed solutions, and keeping questions to a minimum during the renovation itself are especially important.
What’s included in the “Premium” package
1. Measured floor plan
Before design work begins, the key dimensions of the rooms are recorded, along with the location of walls, window and door openings, utilities, and other architectural elements.
The measured floor plan becomes the foundation for developing the layout, technical documentation, and 3D visualizations.
2. Furniture layout plan
A functional layout is developed showing the placement of furniture, plumbing fixtures, and key interior elements.
Room dimensions, ease of movement, ergonomics, storage systems, and the ways the space will be used day to day are all taken into account.
3. Demolition and construction plans
Where necessary, plans are prepared for demolishing existing structures and building new partitions.
This lets the construction crew understand exactly the scope and sequence of the work required.
4. Plumbing fixture layout plan
The exact locations of plumbing fixtures and the required utility connection points are determined.
Bathrooms, guest toilets, kitchens, laundry rooms, and other spaces that require plumbing connections are worked out in detail.
5. Underfloor heating plan
Where necessary, a layout of underfloor heating zones is developed, taking into account the furniture, plumbing fixtures, and specifics of the floor plan.
6. Outlet and electrical connection plan
A plan is developed showing the location of outlets, electrical connection points, and appliance connections.
The electrical layout is designed around the future arrangement of furniture, the kitchen, TVs, workspaces, and other equipment.
7. Light switch plan
The location of switches and the lighting control scenarios are determined.
This makes the lighting convenient to use and allows the necessary electrical connection points to be planned in advance.
8. Lighting plan
A plan is developed showing the placement of general and decorative light sources.
The project may include ceiling fixtures, track systems, pendant lights, wall sconces, LED strip lighting, and other solutions.
9. Ceiling plan
A plan of the ceiling structures is developed, taking into account lighting, built-in elements, and the architecture of the space.
10. Flooring plan
The types and boundaries of floor coverings, laying directions, and transitions between materials are defined.
This makes it possible to agree in advance on the use of parquet, engineered wood flooring, ceramic tile, porcelain tile, and other floor coverings.
11. Room-by-room wall elevations
The “Premium” package includes extended wall elevations for more detailed development of the interior.
The elevations may show furniture, plumbing fixtures, tile, decorative panels, outlets, light fixtures, built-in elements, and other important details.
12. Detail drawings and sections
For complex interior solutions, additional detail drawings, cross-sections, and sectional views are prepared.
They help the construction crew build non-standard structures and complex interior elements more accurately.
13. Specifications and quantity calculations for the main materials
The project includes specifications and information on the main finishing materials called for by the approved concept.
This helps identify the necessary items in advance and simplifies preparation for purchasing and implementation.
Photorealistic 3D visualization of every room
Photorealistic 3D visualizations are created for each main room.
They let you see the future interior in advance and evaluate how materials, furniture, lighting, colors, textiles, and decorative elements work together.
At the visualization stage, the look of the future space can be agreed on in detail before renovation work begins.
The “Premium” package includes up to two full rounds of revisions to the developed concept.
Extended technical documentation
The key difference of the “Premium” package is its higher level of technical detail.

In addition to standard working drawings, the project includes extended wall elevations, detail drawings, sections, specifications, and additional information needed to accurately execute complex interior solutions.
This is especially important for properties with bespoke furniture, decorative panels, non-standard ceiling structures, complex junctions between materials, and a large number of built-in elements.
The more detailed the technical documentation, the fewer decisions have to be made on site during the renovation.
Two material-selection trips with the designer
The package includes two material-selection trips with the designer.
During these trips, you can approve actual samples of tile, flooring, paint, decorative materials, and other interior elements.
This helps bring the finished result as close as possible to the approved 3D visualizations and reduces the risk of unsuccessful material combinations on site.
Properties suited to the “Premium” package

The package is suitable for apartments in new developments, apartments in existing buildings, private houses, condos, investment properties, offices, beauty salons, stores, showrooms, and other commercial spaces.
It is especially well suited to properties with complex architecture, a large amount of built-in furniture, non-standard finishing solutions, and high demands on the quality of execution.
Each project is developed individually, taking into account the architecture of the property, its floor area, its purpose, the budget, and the client’s requirements.
Who the “Premium” package is for

The package is recommended if you need the most thoroughly developed design project, require detailed technical documentation for the construction crew, have many bespoke solutions planned for the interior, or want to minimize the number of questions that come up during the renovation.
It is also a good fit if detailed work on materials, the ability to make more changes to the visual concept, and professional help from the designer in choosing finishing materials matter to you.
“Premium” is the optimal choice for projects where quality of execution and precise adherence to the approved concept are the priority.
What you get

As a result, you receive a thoroughly developed interior design project that includes a functional layout, a furniture arrangement, photorealistic 3D visualizations, an extended set of technical drawings, wall elevations, detail drawings, sections, specifications, and quantity calculations for the main materials.
The package also includes up to two full rounds of revisions to the visual concept and two material-selection trips with the designer.
The project becomes a detailed guide for bringing the interior to life and helps the construction crew follow the approved concept as precisely as possible.
“Premium” package pricing
€50/m²
Minimum package price: €2,500.
The final cost depends on the floor area of the property, the number of rooms, the complexity of the architectural and interior solutions, and the scope of technical documentation required.
How “Premium” differs from the “Basic” package
The “Basic” package includes the core set of technical drawings and provides a complete design project for carrying out the renovation.

“Premium” offers a deeper level of project detail: additional wall elevations, detail drawings and sections, extended specifications and material calculations, up to two full rounds of revisions to the visualizations, and two material-selection trips with the designer.

If the property is complex or it is especially important to you that the interior be executed as precisely as possible, the “Premium” package prepares the project for construction work to a higher standard.
Additional services

If needed, the “Premium” package can be supplemented with design supervision, a detailed cost estimate for construction and finishing work, furnishing and procurement, selection of furniture, lighting, and decor, bespoke furniture design, manufacturing of kitchens, wardrobes, walk-in closets, and other cabinet furniture, furniture delivery and installation, and a turnkey renovation.
This means that once the design project is complete, you can continue working with a single contractor and move straight on to bringing the interior to life.
Interior design in Bratislava and Vienna

DUMSKAYA DESIGN works with residential and commercial properties, combining interior design, photorealistic visualization, technical documentation, custom furniture, and end-to-end project implementation.
The studio’s main geographic focus is Bratislava and Vienna. We also work on projects in other cities across Europe and the USA.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN — interior design, technical design documentation, custom furniture, and end-to-end interior implementation.
Order the “Premium” design package

If you need the most detailed design project possible, with extended technical documentation and additional support from the designer as you prepare for the renovation, the “Premium” package delivers a high level of development at every stage of the project.
